write_acceptance.text:
#!/bin/sh
# Acceptance of task greet. Checks the folder given as the argument (by
# default HETMAN_RUN_DIR); one PASS or FAIL line per criterion.
dir=${1:-$HETMAN_RUN_DIR}
status=0
if [ -s "$dir/greeting.txt" ]; then echo "PASS has-greeting"; else echo "FAIL has-greeting"; status=1; fi
if [ "$(cat "$dir/greeting.txt" 2>/dev/null)" = hello ]; then echo "PASS says-hello"; else echo "FAIL says-hello"; status=1; fi
exit $status
